decisions.reason: S-D5 puts advanced functions on an onscreen menu and the notes list sound, image and channel programming options.
S-D4 gives the advanced functions to users 16-40 within a target of under forty.
The target audience notes say the product should control only the TV.
S-D7 and S-A1 place the screen at the bottom, conflicting with the top placement that S-D8 also states.
S-D8 places the microphone on top.
S-D11 places LED lights under the buttons.
S-D11 and the layout notes use the LEDs to show which functions are active on the buttons.

action_items.reason: S-A5 reorganises documents; no summary part mentions writing minutes.
S-A1 gives the remote layout drawing to the Industrial Designer instead of the User Interface Designer.
S-A3 has the User Interface Designer design the LCD screen menu layout.
S-D12 and the responsibilities notes give the functional aspects to the Industrial Designer.
